subject: Request: Out-of-band offer package for Elias Nakamura (Sr. Inference Engineer)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: OOB sign-on + equity uplift for Elias Nakamura

Hi Markus & Rishi,

We're at final stage with Elias (strong systems + LLM inference background, currently at Zenith AI). Recruiter flagged a competing counteroffer and he asked for an upgraded package. Greenhouse candidate ID is RED-1234 — resume attached.

Current band (Sr. Inference Eng) max base: $200,000. Original verbal offer we prepared: base $195,000 + 0.25% equity + $10k sign-on. Candidate is requesting: base $220,000 OR (preferable to him) a $25k sign-on + 0.4% equity refresh.

We did a quick comp case (attached comp_case.xlsx) showing total first-year on-target comp for both scenarios. Business justification: Elias is a rare infrastructure/latency-focused model engineer who shipped repository-wide KV-cache changes at Zenith and has applied experience with quantization pipelines that map directly to our serving runtime (high impact for GenAI customers). Hiring manager Mina endorses candidate strongly.

Asking: formal approval for an out-of-band sign-on up to $30,000 and equity refresh to 0.35% (or approval to go to 0.4% if committee prefers). This will be charged to the inference hiring bucket / FY27 headcount allocation. If approved, Talent will send a revised offer and a 48-hour acceptance window.

Attachments: offer_packet_v1.pdf (draft), comp_case.xlsx, elias_resume.pdf

Mina
Mina Haddad
Hiring Manager, Inference Team
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: OOB sign-on + equity uplift for Elias Nakamura

Thanks for the context, Mina — this helps. A few quick questions before I can sign off: 

1) Competitive posture: do we have a verbal ask from the candidate about the $220k base, or are they explicitly preferring the sign-on + equity split?
2) Urgency: how soon do you need a decision? You mentioned a 48-hour window — is that from offer send or from candidate's requested deadline?
3) Budget/offset: confirm that this comes from FY27 inference hiring bucket (not a headcount increment request). If we need to pull from a different pool, please note which manager will take the cost center.

Prelim mental model: I'm more comfortable approving a sign-on up to $30k for retention against a counteroffer, with equity uplift to 0.35% as an alternative to increasing base above band. Increasing base above band to $220k has longer-term comp implications (comp bands and future raises). 

Please add the candidate's counteroffer details (if any) and the hiring manager's affirmation of business impact; attach any offer benchmark you used. I'll aim to respond with a final decision today.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Rishi. I reviewed Mina's notes and the comp case. My read: candidate impact is high and this hire is time sensitive (we risk losing to Zenith). I'm comfortable with the following one-time exception, subject to Talent Ops sending a final packet with acceptance terms: 

- Do NOT increase base above band (keep base at $200k / or $195k as originally structured).
- Approve sign-on up to $30,000 (taxed as a one-time payment).
- Approve equity refresh to 0.35% (double-checked with treasury dilution impact).
- Condition: offer must include a 48-hour acceptance window and a clause that the sign-on is forfeited if candidate leaves within 6 months.

Please proceed to finalize. If Compensation prefers to match the 0.4% request, approve that instead; otherwise stick to 0.35%. Thanks.

-Markus
